context.body: The promised sign points beyond the commission to serving God on the same mountain after the people leave Egypt.
context.label: The future sign

observations.body: A bush in the wilderness becomes holy ground when God calls Moses by name.
observations.label: The place changes

observations.body: The LORD says he has seen Israel’s affliction, heard their cry, and knows their sorrows.
observations.label: Seeing and hearing

observations.body: The speech moves from coming down to deliver Israel to bringing them up out of Egypt into another land.
observations.label: Down and up

observations.body: God sends Moses to Pharaoh; Moses asks who he is to go, and the answer begins with promised presence.
observations.label: Moses is sent

payload.posture: Follow the movement from sight and holy ground into speech, affliction, commission, and promised presence.
payload.tension: God says that he has come down to deliver Israel and then sends Moses, who answers by asking, “Who am I?”
payload.title: Seen, heard, and sent
